review_candidates.title: Partnerships Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Consulting, Project Management, and General Business
review_candidates.description: Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform. Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine. That's where you come in. The Role — In Plain English You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets. This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week. Your week might look like this: Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing. You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role. What Makes This Different Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two. You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams. Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done. You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk. Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

review_candidates.title: Marketing & GTM Ops Specialist
review_candidates.description: 🧡 Coverflex Work changed. Pay didn’t. Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone. Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel. We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more. Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees. We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment. ⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials) Role: Marketing & GTM Ops Specialist Seniority Level: Intermediate Type: Individual Contributor Languages: English (main) / Portuguese, Spanish, Italian or German a plus. Main Tools: Clay, Lemlist, HubSpot, Apify, Segment, or BigQuer, N8N, Make, Amplitude Location: Remote (Europe) Compensation Base Salary: €30,000 – €38,000 Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan Benefits: you can check them below (at the end of the page) Contract Type: Permanent ⚠️ How to Apply Important: Only applications submitted through this method will be considered. This role is for builders. So we’re not asking for a traditional CV. Go to coverflexprojects.com and figure out how to apply. 😉 We’re intentionally leaving some of the process for you to discover — after all, figuring things out is kind of the point of this role. 💥 Your Impact This role builds and owns the systems that make Coverflex's GTM engine scale, including automations, AI workflows, integrations, and data flows across four markets: Portugal, Italy, Spain and Germany. Every SQL generated by automated outbound, every self-service signup driven by a growth experiment, and every hour of manual GTM work eliminated runs through infrastructure this person builds. It’s the difference between growth that scales with headcount and growth that scales with systems. You’ll know you’re successful when, after 90 days, you’ve: Built and shipped GTM systems that generate or influence SQLs across our markets Launched growth experiments and automated flows that drive qualified signups How We’ll Measure Success Main KPI 1: SQLs — generated or influenced by motions such as referrals, partners, automated outbound and GTM systems across markets Main KPI 2: Signups — self-service signups driven by growth experiments and automated flows ⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard Let's Be Real — Here's What Makes This Role Challenging Breadth: you'll sit at the intersection of Growth, GTM, Ops, Data and AI, supporting Marketing, Sales and Product across four markets — each with different funnels, systems and data quirks. There is no playbook. Many of the systems you'll build will start from scratch, so you'll need to own problems end to end rather than wait for detailed tickets or specifications. Reliability matters. These automations support revenue-critical processes, so a workflow that silently breaks can mean lost pipeline, missed opportunities or bad data. The tooling landscape moves fast. You'll need to evaluate, adopt or kill tools quickly without chasing shiny objects — and when the right tool doesn't exist, you'll be expected to build the solution yourself. You'll constantly translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. The systems you build only create leverage if the teams using them trust them, understand them and can rely on them. This is not a role where you'll spend your time simply maintaining campaigns or optimising existing workflows. You'll be expected to spot opportunities, build solutions and make systems better. 👤 You Must-haves Experience in GTM Engineering, Growth Ops, marketing or sales automation Strong experience with n8n or similar workflow builders Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and custom integrations Hands-on knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and AI workflows Familiarity with concepts like RAG and MCP A strong understanding of how Marketing, Sales, Growth, and Ops work together A business mindset, with a focus on growth, speed, reliability, and measurable impact Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn complex problems into clear systems Ability to own multiple projects and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams A track record of building and shipping systems, automations or workflows that solved a real business problem Nice-to-have Experience building AI agents, SDR/BDR systems, or internal GTM tools Experience managing, testing, and versioning prompts Basic JavaScript, Python, or SQL Experience with tools like Clay, Lemlist, HubSpot, Apify, Segment, or BigQuery Experience working across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Ops Experience documenting systems and enabling non-technical teams to use them Experience working across multiple European markets Don’t check every box? That’s fine. If you’re curious, technical, business-minded, and love figuring out better ways to build and run GTM systems, we’d still love to hear from you. 🧬 Your DNA Deeply curious: you constantly question how things could be done differently, faster, or more effectively Proactive by default: you don't wait for instructions or predefined playbooks — you bring ideas and test hypotheses Creative and analytical: you think boldly and unconventionally while maintaining a strong focus on measurement and business impact Comfortable with ambiguity: you move quickly and run experiments that may fail, because you know breakthrough growth comes from exploration Pragmatic and tool-agnostic: you care about solving the problem, not using a particular tool. You'll buy, build or combine whatever gets to the best outcome Execution-driven: you know your impact today, your plan for tomorrow, and what needs to happen to move your projects forward Transparent: you communicate clearly about what you've built, how it works, what could break and — importantly — how you use AI in your work You’ll probably find this frustrating if… You're only comfortable optimising existing channels rather than discovering new ones You need constant direction or validation before taking action You think in terms of campaigns rather than experiments and systems You're uncomfortable with uncertainty or incremental by default You ship fast but don't care about monitoring, error handling, documentation or what happens when things break You enjoy experimenting with tools but struggle to explain what business problem the tool actually solves 👥 Manager & Team Meet Your Manager Hiring Manager: Pedro Azevedo - Marketing Ops Manager Location: Portugal LinkedIn Profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pedroazevedo22/ Profile Snapshot Energy: Builder's pace — pragmatic, curious, always experimenting with new tools and better ways to work Communication: Clear and async-first — Slack and quick huddles, context up front, decisions fast Feedback Style: Frequent and specific — about the work, never the person, and welcome in both directions How to work with me - in the Manager's own words: "My management style is built on clarity. You'll always know what we're trying to achieve, why it matters to the business, and how we'll measure it — the how is yours to own. I don't do micromanagement and I don't do surprises: we keep priorities visible, talk often, and course-correct early instead of at the deadline. I take what you build seriously, which means I'll ask hard questions — about reliability, about impact, about whether we're even solving the right problem — because I want your work to matter, not just to exist. When something wins, the credit is yours; when something fails, we debug it together and move on smarter. Expect honesty in both directions, fast decisions, and a manager genuinely invested in making you better at your craft, helping you deep-dive in your projects in detail." Your Team You'll join the Growth Ops team and you'll work alongside two peers on shared projects, with Pedro Costa (Head of Growth) leading the wider Growth team. You'll Work Closely With Local Marketing teams across our markets PLG Team Product Data & Analytics Revenue Operations Your work will sit at the intersection of these teams, turning growth and GTM opportunities into scalable systems and workflows. Team Rituals And Ways Of Working Weekly team meetings / syncs Regular 1:1 with Pedro Async collaboration through Slack and documentation in Notion Shared project work across Growth Ops and the wider Growth team 💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity) We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree. We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields. No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation , or any other protected ground. Assessment Fairness We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced). We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage). 📬 Application Clarity No cover letter required. Apply with your LinkedIn or your CV . You may be asked a few short, relevant questions. Total candidate time investment: ~3–4 hours end-to-end. 🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long) CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves Done by People + Hiring Manager. You’ll hear from us within 10 business days. Hiring Manager Interview + Quiz - Deep dive into your work 45 min Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration. Meet the Head of Growth 45 min Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration. People Interview - Allow us to know you! 30 min With People. Stress-free virtual coffee, focused on getting to know you as a person. We talk about culture, beliefs, and purpose. Meet the Team: CMO & Head of Growth 30 min A conversation with the team you’d be joining while giving you a clearer picture of how the team operates day to day. Final Conversation (CEO / C-Level) — Values, strategy, and your growth 30 min 🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions. Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers. Meeting recorder (e.g., Talka.ai): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation. ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries. Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent. ⏱️ Speed & Communication Decision: within 4 weeks of your application. Updates: weekly if the process runs longer. Scheduling: interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe). Feedback: from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.

Identify priority countries, defense programs, customer segments, and opportunities where a partner can materially accelerate access, contracting, integration, or adoption. Communicate with Executive Leadership: Review the prospective and active partnership portfolio, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, performance, risks, and strategic opportunities across Europe. review_candidates.company: Medical Equipment Calibration Lab. (MECL)- Faculty of Engineering
review_candidates.description: Are you a dedicated and detail-oriented Biomedical Engineer with a passion for ensuring the safety and accuracy of medical equipment? The Medical Equipment Calibration Laboratory (MECL), part of the esteemed Faculty of Engineering at Cairo University, is seeking a Biomedical Test & Calibration Engineer to join our team in Cairo. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of medical equipment quality control. You'll work on-site, traveling to various hospitals and healthcare facilities across Egypt to perform crucial testing and calibration. Your commitment and technical expertise will directly impact patient safety and care, ensuring that vital medical devices meet rigorous national and international standards. Note: IF YOU ARE NOT BIOMEDICAL ENGINEER OR RELATED DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS POSITION Key Responsibilities On-site Testing & Calibration: Perform hands-on testing and calibration of a wide range of medical equipment at various locations throughout the Arab Republic of Egypt. Travel is a necessary and integral part of this role. Quality Assurance: Ensure all testing and calibration procedures comply with industry standards and regulations. Documentation & Reporting: Meticulously document all procedures, results, and findings in detailed reports. Technical Marketing & Client Relations: Act as a technical representative during site visits, fostering strong relationships with clients. Collaboration: Participate in technical committees and contribute to evaluations and report writing. Qualifications & Requirements A Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or an equivalent field. 0-2 years of experience in a related field, with a preference for experience in medical equipment calibration or maintenance. A solid understanding of biomedical equipment applications, management, and maintenance procedures. The ability to read and interpret medical standards and technical documents. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Exceptional commitment and a willingness to travel extensively within Egypt. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo. The role offers a competitive gross salary based on experience, with potential for bonuses and transportation compensation. Note: IF YOU ARE NOT BIOMEDICAL ENGINEER OR RELATED DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS POSITION Note: The initial training period is unpaid, and its duration will be tailored to your individual capabilities. Ready to make a tangible impact on the healthcare industry in Egypt? Send your resume to Prof. Sherif ElGohary sherif.elgohary@eng.cu.edu.eg to apply.

review_candidates.title: Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Avoca Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers. We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 130+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office. In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact. About The Role Customers don't remember when things work, but they remember when things break and how fast you fix them. As a Support Engineer at Avoca, you're the person who makes that moment go well. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You'll own customer issues end-to-end: triaging incoming tickets, debugging production systems, reasoning through configuration and data flow, and driving problems to resolution, often without needing to hand anything off. You'll work across classification logic, pricing, scheduling, availability, prompt behavior, and other configurable layers of our platform, using internal tools and AI-assisted workflows to move fast. When issues reveal deeper product gaps, you'll partner with Solutions Engineers and Engineering to surface patterns and push fixes upstream. Your judgment directly shapes customer trust, product reliability, and our ability to scale. What You'll Do Debug independently by tracing system state, configuration, workflows, and data flow across production environments. Own support tickets from first response through confirmed resolution, no tossing over the fence. Diagnose issues spanning classification logic, pricing and fees, scheduling, objection handling, and other configurable behaviors. Use internal tooling and AI-assisted workflows to investigate and resolve issues efficiently. Maintain high operational rigor in triage, prioritization, and communication with customers. Surface recurring failure patterns that inform product and engineering improvements. What You'll Bring 3-6+ years in a technical, execution-heavy role: Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer, or similar. Strong debugging instincts and comfort operating in production environments where you won't always have a playbook. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, webhooks, and configuration-driven systems. The ability to reason through complex system behavior from first principles, not just follow runbooks. Clear, direct communication — you explain what happened, why, and what you did about it. A bias toward ownership. You'd rather solve the problem than route the ticket. Who You Are Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in fast-moving, high-growth environments. Thrives on owning processes end-to-end and balancing multiple initiatives simultaneously. Autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity. A proactive and effective communicator. You are collaborative, organized, and efficient. Eager to work in person at our NYC office full time. Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance Company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell Flexible PTO plus U.S. federal holidays Company-wide off-sites Daily in-office lunch through Parkday Dinner covered when working late Commuter benefits and late-night rideshare Monthly wellness stipend Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request All core tools and software provided Compensation: The expected base salary for this role is $120,000-$150,000 with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca’s total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process. Why Avoca At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. Avoca provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. Compensation Range: $120K - $150K
